title: Prefill dechunker & sequence harmonizer for minimal-pad micro-batching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a lightweight harmonizer stage that reduces padding waste by coalescing near-length requests, de-chunking client-sent prefill fragments, and suppressing unnecessary pad tokens while respecting latency SLOs.
background: Current coarse bucketing causes significant pad waste when short and long requests are mixed. Benchmarks referenced in earlier tickets indicate ~12-18% pad token waste. We need an online solution that favors KV cache locality and avoids kernel thrashing while offering safe pad trimming heuristics.
acceptance_criteria: >= 20% reduction in pad tokens on mixed synthetic workload compared to baseline bucketing
P95 latency regression <= 5% on tail-sensitive workloads
Feature is gated and controllable per-customer via Console and Dedicated/Private config
Integration tests and nightly perf harnesses validate pad delta and cost estimates on merge
technical_notes: Add a harmonizer middleware in the router that tags requests with affinity based on sequence length, prefill vs decode, model version, and KV-cache presence
Affinity drives an online micro-bucket allocator which groups requests within a dynamic epsilon; allocator respects a configurable max_hold_ms to bound added latency
Prefill de-chunking: detect client-chunked prefill sequences and merge into a single logical prefill to avoid repeated KV writes and inter-chunk padding
Pad suppression heuristic: trim padded tokens inside a micro-batch when attention masks indicate no cross-request attention dependencies; validate against attention mask semantics before trimming
Expose kernel affinity mapping per-tag so harmonizer favors packing that matches preferred kernel memory layout (minimize kernel switches like FlashAttention -> fallback kernels)
Prefer KV-local scheduling: soft time-windowing to favor requests that can reuse warmed KV slots even if micro-batch density is slightly lower
Fallback behavior: if aggregator cannot form a candidate within max_hold_ms, forward immediately to preserve latency SLO
Emit harmonizer telemetry (bucket_id, hold_time_ms, pad_saved_tokens, kernel_choice) to tracing and Console metrics
testing_plan: Unit tests for de-chunk detection, affinity tagging, and pad-suppression safety checks
Synthetic perf benchmark with mixed-length distributions (8k/512/128) to validate pad and latency targets
Staging A/B: route 10% of traffic through harmonizer and compare pad-saved, cost-per-token, and tail latency against control
Nightly CI job on a small GPU fleet asserting <5% regression for P95/P99 and pad reduction thresholds
rollout_plan: Feature gated in runtime-1.24; runtime config exposes max_hold_ms and length_epsilon
Console toggle for per-customer opt-in and diagnostic view for harmonizer metrics
Auto-disable and failover to legacy bucketing if errors or latency regressions exceed safe thresholds
